title: StageLayoutActionRequest
description: Body of the idempotent stage-layout action POST operation.

request_id.description: Client-generated idempotency identity, scoped to the authenticated desk session.

StageLayoutAction.description:
One stage-layout intent, using the shared fan-out vocabulary: an explicitly ordered
selection plus a typed operation payload (see `ProgrammingValueMutation::SetSelection`).

oneOf.description:
Applies one uniform axis delta to every selected fixture that has a resolvable stage
position. Fixtures without a stored 2D or 3D position are skipped, never defaulted.

delta.description: Meters for translation axes, degrees for rotation axes. Must be finite.

StagePositionAxis.description: One editable component of a fixture's 3D stage position.
